# proxmox_realm (Resource)

Manages an external Proxmox VE 9 LDAP, Active Directory, or OpenID Connect authentication realm through `/access/domains`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

resource "proxmox_realm" "sso" {
  realm      = "corp-sso"
  type       = "openid"
  issuer_url = "https://id.example.com"
  client_id  = "proxmox"

  client_key         = var.proxmox_oidc_client_key
  client_key_version = 1

  username_claim = "email"
  scopes         = "openid email profile"
  audiences      = "proxmox"
  autocreate     = true
  comment        = "Corporate OpenID Connect realm"
}

# LDAP realm with directory sync, a client certificate and a forced TOTP factor.
resource "proxmox_realm" "ldap" {
  realm     = "corp-ldap"
  type      = "ldap"
  server1   = "ldap.example.com"
  base_dn   = "dc=example,dc=com"
  user_attr = "uid"

  bind_dn               = "cn=terraform,dc=example,dc=com"
  bind_password         = var.proxmox_ldap_bind_password
  bind_password_version = 1

  cert         = "/etc/pve/priv/realm/corp-ldap.crt"
  cert_key     = "/etc/pve/priv/realm/corp-ldap.key"
  filter       = "(objectClass=person)"
  user_classes = "inetorgperson, posixaccount"

  # Group sync keeps the base DN, object classes and name attribute separate.
  group_dn        = "ou=groups,dc=example,dc=com"
  group_name_attr = "cn"
  group_filter    = "(objectClass=groupOfNames)"
  group_classes   = "groupOfNames, group"

  sync_attributes       = "email=mail,firstname=givenName"
  sync_defaults_options = "remove-vanished=entry,scope=users"
  case_sensitive        = true

  tfa = {
    type   = "oath"
    digits = 6
    step   = 30
  }

  comment = "Corporate LDAP directory"
}

# OpenID realm that maps directory groups into Proxmox groups.
resource "proxmox_realm" "sso_groups" {
  realm      = "corp-sso-groups"
  type       = "openid"
  issuer_url = "https://id.example.com"
  client_id  = "proxmox"

  client_key         = var.proxmox_oidc_client_key
  client_key_version = 1

  username_claim    = "email"
  groups_claim      = "groups"
  groups_autocreate = true
  groups_overwrite  = true
}

# Client certificate content instead of a path: the PEM files are uploaded to
# the iso directory of the given storage and the realm points at them. Use a
# shared storage on multi-node clusters so every node can read the files.
resource "proxmox_realm" "ldap_cert_content" {
  realm     = "corp-ldap-cert"
  type      = "ldap"
  server1   = "ldap.example.com"
  base_dn   = "dc=example,dc=com"
  user_attr = "uid"

  bind_dn               = "cn=terraform,dc=example,dc=com"
  bind_password         = var.proxmox_ldap_bind_password
  bind_password_version = 1

  cert_storage     = "local"
  cert_content     = file("realm-client.crt")
  cert_key_content = file("realm-client.key")
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `realm` (String) Authentication realm identifier. The built-in `pam` and `pve` realms are not supported. Changes require replacement.
- `type` (String) External realm type: `ldap`, `ad`, or `openid`. Changes require replacement.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `acr_values` (String) OpenID Authentication Context Class Reference values.
- `audiences` (String) Additional OpenID audiences accepted alongside `client_id` (Proxmox VE 9).
- `autocreate` (Boolean) Automatically create Proxmox users after a successful OpenID login.
- `base_dn` (String) LDAP base distinguished name. Required for `ldap` and optional for `ad`.
- `bind_dn` (String) LDAP bind distinguished name.
- `bind_password` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) LDAP bind password. Requires Terraform 1.11 or later and must be paired with `bind_password_version`. The value is never stored in plan or state.
- `bind_password_version` (Number) Version counter for `bind_password`. Increment it to rotate the password; removing it deletes a previously managed remote password.
- `ca_path` (String) Path on the Proxmox cluster to the LDAP CA certificate file or directory.
- `case_sensitive` (Boolean) Treat LDAP/AD user names as case-sensitive. The Proxmox default is `true`.
- `cert` (String) Path on the cluster to the LDAP/AD client certificate.
- `cert_content` (String, Sensitive) PEM client certificate, uploaded as `<cert_storage>/template/iso/terraform-realm-<realm>-cert.img` and referenced through `cert`. Mutually exclusive with `cert`. Changes require replacement.
- `cert_key` (String) Path on the cluster to the LDAP/AD client certificate key.
- `cert_key_content` (String, Sensitive) PEM client certificate key belonging to `cert_content`. Changes require replacement.
- `cert_storage` (String) Iso-capable directory storage holding `cert_content` and `cert_key_content`. Shared storage is required on multi-node clusters, otherwise only the upload node can read the files. Changes require replacement.
- `client_id` (String) OpenID Connect client identifier. Required for `openid`.
- `client_key` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) OpenID Connect client secret. Requires Terraform 1.11 or later and must be paired with `client_key_version`. The provider discards any value returned by Proxmox and never stores it in plan or state.
- `client_key_version` (Number) Version counter for `client_key`. Increment it to rotate the secret; removing it deletes a previously managed remote client key.
- `comment` (String) Realm description shown in the Proxmox login interface.
- `default` (Boolean) Use this realm as the cluster default. Proxmox clears this setting from every other realm when enabled.
- `domain` (String) Active Directory domain name. Required for `ad`.
- `filter` (String) LDAP/AD filter applied during user sync.
- `group_classes` (String) Comma separated object classes that identify group entries during sync.
- `group_dn` (String) Base DN for group sync. Defaults to `base_dn` when omitted.
- `group_filter` (String) LDAP/AD filter applied during group sync.
- `group_name_attr` (String) LDAP attribute that carries a group name; the first DN value is used when omitted.
- `groups_autocreate` (Boolean) Create Proxmox groups from OpenID group claims.
- `groups_claim` (String) OpenID claim that carries group memberships.
- `groups_overwrite` (Boolean) Overwrite existing Proxmox group memberships from OpenID group claims.
- `issuer_url` (String) OpenID Connect issuer URL. Required for `openid`.
- `mode` (String) LDAP protocol mode: `ldap`, `ldaps`, or `ldap+starttls`.
- `port` (Number) LDAP or Active Directory server port.
- `prompt` (String) OpenID authorization prompt value.
- `query_userinfo` (Boolean) Query the OpenID userinfo endpoint for claim values.
- `scopes` (String) Space-separated OpenID scopes.
- `server1` (String) Primary LDAP or Active Directory server. Required for `ldap` and `ad`.
- `server2` (String) Fallback LDAP or Active Directory server.
- `sync_attributes` (String) Comma separated `pveField=ldapAttribute` mappings applied during user sync, for example `email=mail`.
- `sync_defaults_options` (String) Default options for sync runs, such as `remove-vanished=entry;acl,scope=users`. Passed through unchanged.
- `tfa` (Attributes) Realm-level two-factor requirement. Proxmox stores this as a property string and only LDAP/AD realms support it; the Yubico `key` is kept in `/etc/pve/domains.cfg` in plaintext. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tfa))
- `user_attr` (String) LDAP attribute containing the username. Required for `ldap` and optional for `ad`.
- `user_classes` (String) Comma separated object classes that identify user entries during sync.
- `username_claim` (String) OpenID claim used as the username. Proxmox fixes this value at realm creation, so changes require replacement.
- `verify` (Boolean) Verify the LDAP server TLS certificate.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Realm identifier (same as `realm`).

<a id="nestedatt--tfa"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tfa`

Required:

- `type` (String) Second factor: `oath` (TOTP) or `yubico`.

Optional:

- `digits` (Number) TOTP digit count between 6 and 8.
- `id` (String) Yubico API ID.
- `key` (String) Yubico API key.
- `step` (Number) TOTP time period in seconds, at least 10.
- `url` (String) Yubico API URL.
